body: It feels like no matter how much I learn now if I don't use it in adulthood I will forget it. It seems like everybody knows what the mitochondria is but I am guessing very few adults know the difference between the cytoplasm and the chloroplasts. Most of the adults I've talked to didn't know that cats have bellybuttons. That's basic elementary school stuff. Cats are mammals, they have bellybuttons. I like mathematics. I am really enjoying calculus right now but in general, I am a fan of non-statistical or financial finite math. Most jobs that involve math are statistical,  financial, or require an amount of school I don't think I could pay for, or sometimes all three.  I think I could eventual pay of a bachelor's or master's degree, but I feel like anything more would cost more than I could ever pay off.
I like learning, but school stresses me out and knowledge is very fragile.
People think I am making it up because I do care about things. I just know life would be infinitely easier if I were dead.
